maddeler.e:
ابتنيا (form VIII)
# اِبْتَنَيَا (ibtanayā) /ib.ta.na.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
# اُبْتُنِيَا (ubtuniyā) /ub.tu.ni.jaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
# اِبْتَنِيَا (ibtaniyā) /ib.ta.ni.jaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
